findings.message: Statistic or study claim with no source link in the paragraph.
'Best/top' claim with no verifiable basis in the ficha.
Carrier is not listed as accepted in the ficha.

findings.quote: Studies show that about 70% of adults who keep to a six-month schedule avoid a major restoration over the following five years.
findings.why: This is an invented statistic with no cited study, and it cannot be verified against ADA or NIDCR guidance.
findings.fix: Remove the statistic, or replace it with a real, linked source that supports a clearly worded claim.

findings.quote: Austin's top-rated dental team offers checkups and cleanings with X-rays when they are needed.
findings.why: "Top-rated" is an unsupported superlative with no rating source, and the ficha lists no awards.
findings.fix: Replace with a factual statement such as "Our Austin team offers checkups and cleanings with X-rays when needed."

findings.quote: We are in network with Delta Dental, Aetna and MetLife, and our front desk can check your benefits before you come in.
findings.why: Aetna is not an accepted carrier in the ficha (Delta Dental, Cigna, MetLife), and the ficha does not say "in network".
findings.fix: Name only the accepted carriers: "We accept Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife", and avoid "in network" unless the ficha supports it.

findings.why: This internal link does not exist in the ficha pages list; the correct path is /services/cleanings-exams only if listed, and the listed page is /services/cleanings-exams (cleanings-exams vs cleanings-exams mismatch is not present) — the ficha actually lists /services/cleanings-exams as /services/cleanings-exams, so verify exact path.
findings.fix: Point the link to the ficha page /services/cleanings-exams exactly as listed, i.e. /services/cleanings-exams after confirming the slug matches the ficha entry /services/cleanings-exams.

findings.quote: If you are new to us and paying without insurance, the new patient exam with X-rays is $129.
findings.why: The $129 price matches the ficha, but the ficha attaches no no-insurance condition, so that qualifier is an addition worth confirming.
findings.fix: Confirm with the clinic whether $129 applies only to patients without insurance, or state the price without the condition.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional practice created for a software demonstration. This post is sample content.
findings.why: A demo disclaimer in the body would be wrong on a real published post, though it is consistent with the fictional ficha.
findings.fix: Remove it if the post is ever published for a real practice.

findings.why: The schema fields match the visible text, but a BlogPosting publisher is normally an Organization and the Dentist type is not strictly valid there.
findings.fix: Use an Organization publisher, or add a separate Dentist/LocalBusiness block with address and hours.
